integrity: The open primary PDF was inspected at the transformation, exact CDF and density, the exponentiated-G series representation, and the FEx-Kumaraswamy endpoint asymptotics. The distinct 2025 family carrying the same FEx-G label was inspected at its defining CDF, and general T-X literature was checked for broader coverage. The survival and hazard limits are proved directly from the exact transform, and the standalone checker was replayed from its packaged path.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the ultimate upper endpoint and does not restrict finite-range hazard flexibility.
Hazard equivalence requires absolute continuity and positive baseline density near the endpoint.
The simple extreme-quantile constant beyond exact Pareto tails requires the usual regularity for inversion of a regularly varying tail.
title: FEx-G preserves the baseline upper-tail class
